patterns.note: Asymmetric hero section with a large, left-aligned heading and a right-aligned list of services, creating a dynamic visual balance.

Consistent use of a bold, sans-serif typeface for all headings and a lighter weight for body text, maintaining strong hierarchy. Arrow icons are frequently used as visual bullet points or directional indicators.
A high-contrast palette of black and off-white is consistently accented by a soft, light pink background for key sections, providing visual segmentation and brand identity.
A large, abstract geometric graphic is positioned in the background, creating a parallax-like effect as foreground content scrolls over it, adding depth and visual interest.
The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, ensuring constant access to site navigation.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background color changes (white, light pink, black), creating distinct content blocks that guide the user's eye down the page.

technique_notes: A fixed header bar is implemented to keep the site navigation persistently visible at the top of the screen during scrolling.

A large, abstract geometric graphic is rendered as a background element, potentially using canvas for animation, and is set to scroll at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a parallax depth effect.

Visual hierarchy is established through a type scale that features oversized, bold sans-serif headings contrasted with a clean, readable sans-serif for body text, often accompanied by custom arrow icons for lists and navigation.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a clean, legible sans-serif for body copy, creating a strong and modern hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all elements, contributing to a clean and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a more compact grid for feature cards and team members.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the prominent use of a large, abstract geometric graphic that acts as a dynamic background element, creating a unique sense of depth and visual intrigue. This, combined with a high-contrast, limited color palette featuring a soft pink accent, elevates the design beyond a typical corporate site.
